Application Review
Applications are reviewed by the Graduate Admissions Committee of the Department of Chemical Engineering. The committee makes recommendations of admission to the Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies Office (GPSO) when a qualified applicant is matched with a supervisor and financial support. Applicants should receive an acceptance or rejection letter from McGill 2-3 weeks after the applicable application closing date.
Please note, McGill’s Department of Chemical Engineering cannot issue application fee waivers.
